title: Home after an overhasty decision

captions.energy: Dismissing routines because of one flaw

meaning: The wish for a clear, joyful home can support change, but abruptly dismissing the old routine can remove comforts that still work.
text: In Muladhara, you want to see the result of shared care: home feels comfortable and bright, with room for simple pleasures. The Empress in the physical position describes creating this through daily actions. The Tower in energy tests your footing through wanting to discard a familiar arrangement when a weak point appears. The Sun in emotions seeks clear, shared joy and responds readily to visible improvement. Yet the wish finally to see a good result can encourage too sharp a rejection of things that still help you live peacefully together.

For example, after one awkward gathering, you decide the dining space is completely wrong. You want to remove furniture, replace the crockery and produce a room to feel proud of all at once. **Clarity starts with what exactly proved uncomfortable.** Perhaps only an extra chair or a complicated table setting caused difficulty. Enjoyment comes closer when care preserves the home’s good details and addresses the actual reason the evening did not work.

The difficulty is expecting joy only from complete renewal. A partial improvement then feels too modest, and successful earlier arrangements go unnoticed. You invest effort in a beautiful fresh start and become tired before enjoying the result. Shared footing grows firmer when admitting a mistake does not require declaring the entire former routine a failure or earning the right to feel good at home all over again.
